biotools.summary: ArchVelo is a computational framework designed for single-cell multi-omics data. It models gene regulation and infers developmental trajectories from paired single-cell chromatin accessibility (scATAC-seq) and transcriptomic (scRNA-seq) data using archetypal methods.
biotools.name: ArchVelo: Archetypal Velocity Modeling
